product_family: AI-powered writing assistance and productivity platform. Consumer tiers: Free, Premium, Pro; enterprise tier: Enterprise. Additional products: Superhuman Go (productivity agents), Superhuman Mail (email), Grammarly for Education, Docs.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 (Type 2) examinations validate that Grammarly meets the strict SOC 2 standards for security, availability, confidentiality, and privacy

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 3 - Public report describing validated controls; available as of 2023

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Certificate dated June 23, 2025. Confirms Grammarly has established, implemented, maintained, and continually improving an information security management system

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015
certifications.proof_quote: Certificate dated June 23, 2025. Demonstrates compliance with security requirements for cloud service providers and customers

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019
certifications.proof_quote: Covers protection of users' personal information in cloud environments

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy information management system. Verifies Grammarly meets requirements for privacy information management

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
certifications.proof_quote: Responsible AI development and use requirements. ISO 42001 certification active as of 2023, demonstrating AI governance maturity

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Payment card industry data security standard - Active compliance

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Grammarly complies with GDPR via ISO 27701 and certifies compliance with EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, UK Extension, and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (cert at dataprivacyframework.gov)

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Grammarly is HIPAA compliant. Users must not store, transmit, or process Protected Health Information unless they have entered into a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with Grammarly

privacy.ai_training_note: Grammarly can use customer data to train AI models by default for Free/Premium/Pro tiers. OFF by default for Enterprise, Business, and Education tiers. Users can disable via Product Improvement and Training control in account settings. Grammarly restricts third-party AI service providers from training on customer content.
privacy.data_region: US East (AWS) with international transfers. EU/UK/Swiss users covered by Data Privacy Framework

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 server-side encryption via AWS KMS

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Amazon Web Services (US East region) with native backup tools, load balancers, and web application firewalls

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Third-party penetration testing and HackerOne bug bounty program

security.name: Data ownership
security.value: User words are owned by users; Grammarly does not sell or monetize user content

products.name: Grammarly Free
products.data_scope: User writing content for grammar/clarity checks
products.notes: AI training enabled by default. Basic writing features. No cost.

products.name: Grammarly Premium
products.data_scope: User writing content including tone and style suggestions
products.notes: AI training enabled by default. Advanced suggestions, tone detection, plagiarism checker.

products.name: Grammarly Pro
products.data_scope: User writing content with team collaboration
products.notes: AI training ON by default for single-user and web-purchased plans; OFF by default for Sales-team purchases. Generative AI features, style guides, team collaboration.

products.name: Grammarly Enterprise
products.data_scope: Organization writing content with confidential mode option
products.notes: AI training OFF by default. Confidential mode, granular permissions, data loss prevention, unlimited users, dedicated support.

products.name: Superhuman Go
products.notes: Part of Superhuman Platform acquisition. Productivity agents for docs and workflows.

products.name: Grammarly for Education
products.notes: AI training OFF by default for all education accounts.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (Free tier + Premium monthly/yearly + Pro + Enterprise contact sales)
compare.data_residency: US East (AWS) with international transfer capability. DPA available for enterprise.

flags: CORPORATE CHANGE: Grammarly acquired by/merged into Superhuman Platform Inc. Privacy policy and DPA inquiries now redirect to Superhuman domain. Verify ongoing separation of product tiers.

AI TRAINING DEFAULTS: Consumer Free/Premium/Pro tiers have AI training ON by default. While opt-out is clearly available, this differs from Enterprise-by-default-OFF posture. Note for procurement: tier selection matters.
DATA RESIDENCY: Primary infrastructure is US East (AWS). While DPA compliance stated, EU/UK users should confirm data localization requirements.
BAA REQUIREMENT: HIPAA compliance is conditional on BAA execution. Not a default feature; users must request and execute agreement.
